messages.subject: Passing Input Variables Through Code
parts:
Perhaps this is a question for the manipulatr group, but here goes...

Problem: I want to have an Shiny input, which is then passed to some dplyr code to:

    1) group/summarize a data set and,
    2) plot the data with ggplot2

I'll sketch the problem w/ minimal code for simplicity:

Given:

UI.R
input$my_variable
plotOutput(my_plot)
server.R
df  ##the data set; dim is O(1,000 rows x 40 vars)

cut <- group_by_(df, ~my_variable) ##this is do-able thanks to dplyr 0.3

summary <- summarise(cut, ...) ##no problem here

my_plot <- renderplot(ggplot(summary, aes(x =~my_variable,...) ##ggplot doesn't like this

Qs
Is there a workaround?
Can ggvis do this?
Should I generally be transitioning away from ggplot2 to ggvis anyway?
